title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A 3 by 3 board of light tiles seen from the front and above. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; an orange disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow on the token pointing along a move that brings it one step closer. Readouts give moves made and steps to goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Count the rows and columns between the token and the goal: the shortest route is their sum, 4 moves from the start.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up moves the token away from the camera's starting view (toward the goal row); the hint arrow shows a move that lowers steps to goal by 1.
